path: A3 (dalvik vm properties + odrefresh log bypass)

earlier_paths.A1_blocker: Precompiling ART boot image / services.jar requires an aarch64 dex2oat64 cross-compiler and full AOSP build environment which does not exist on macOS Darwin host; no precompiled .art/.oat/.vdex files exist in staged guest inputs.
earlier_paths.A2_blocker: odrefresh hardcodes 120s timeout in C++ constexpr kDex2oatTimeoutSeconds = 120; no property or init configuration exists to configure it. In addition, compiling 21 APEX bootclasspath jars under QEMU TCG emulation requires multiple hours and cannot finish in the flight window.

odrefresh_compilation_log.effect: odrefresh detects recent compilation attempt and skips compilation with kOkay (exit code 0), preventing dex2oat timeout

zygote_verification_bypass.effect: ART runtime sets VerifyMode::kNone, skipping all 272 bootclasspath method verifications and allowing Zygote to fork system_server immediately
